cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'd like one corner of reality returned to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just say 'out' without attaching your trophy to it.

mechanism: A concedes the overall match, offers to preserve the score and asks only for one disputed out call to be released.
confusable: Unlike demanding a rematch or general vindication, A bounds the concession to one claim without reopening victory.
comparison: A point call and score sheet differ from travel credit and a restaurant caption.
seedUse: D204-a ball out and match retained; S02-a gives B explicit protection from wider consequences.
